button.label: Copy prompt
button.text:
Run a Lead Source Review on our last 12 full months. Use the lead-source-review skill.
Our team is [team name]. The attached files are [list each file: closings with the lead source on each, the P&L or a list of lead spend by source, and what we pay platforms like Zillow at closing].
Every agent and staff name on the team: [names, comma separated].
Read the files, sort every label into the nine buckets, and send me one message with the period, the flagged questions, the bucket table and the questions our files can't answer. Wait for my answers before you score.
Read only. Never change a lead or anything in our CRM. Never send.

claude.text: The only file the review can't run without is closings by lead source. A missing file is never a reason to guess. The report lists it as a number to bring next time.

title: Confirm the Buckets
done: Every flagged label answered and the bucket table confirmed
goal: Answer the flagged labels and confirm the bucket table.

claude.title: Confirm the Buckets
claude.note: Recording w2-02 (one cut for both paths).

claude.title: Check the period it used
claude.detail: The message starts with the exact months. If two of your numbers disagreed, it says which one it used.

claude.title: Answer the flagged labels
claude.detail: Labels it couldn't place, biggest first. A name in the lead source field might be an agent or a referral partner. Tell it which.

claude.title: Confirm the bucket table
claude.detail: Each bucket with its closings, its share and the labels that fed it. One wrong bucket moves every number after it. If you say nothing about the table, it stands as shown.

claude.title: Check how many closings are Unassigned
claude.detail: Over 30% Unassigned and the mix can't be graded. If you know where those closings came from, say so now.

claude.title: Answer the questions files can't
claude.detail: How many agents and whose closings were yours. Who owns each big bucket. Your sphere size. When each paid source started. Skip any you can't answer.

claude.text: If spend by source adds up to more than your total advertising, the review stops and asks. It is usually a charge counted twice or a referral fee sitting in spend. Tell it which number is right.

claude.title: The Nine Buckets
paras: Every lead source gets one home. There is no "other."
head: Bucket
What Goes In
rows: Past clients, sphere, their referrals, friends and family
Anything bought up front: PPC, paid social, portal subscriptions, Ylopo, BoomTown
Platforms that take a referral fee: Zillow Preferred, ReadyConnect, HomeLight, Movoto
Expireds, FSBOs, circle calls, doors, Vulcan and Mojo lists
Old or imported leads with no recorded source
Sign calls and inquiries on the team's own listings
Website and SEO, organic social, mailers, farming

claude.title: Bucketing Rules
paras: Blanks and labels like "unknown" show as Unassigned, so the gap is visible.
The relationship beats the channel. A past client who comes back through a portal counts as Sphere.
Name where the lead came from, not the tool that caught it.

claude.detail: In Google Drive, make AI Office / Lead Desk / inbox. Export teams drop the CRM's speed-to-lead report here each Monday. Connected teams leave it empty, as the fallback.

claude.title: Test Sisu's speed to lead
claude.detail: Connected teams only. In a new chat in your AI Office project, paste this. If each lead shows a first response time and call attempts, keep the Sisu line in the prompt. If not, use the export line for now.

button.text: Using Sisu, list our new leads from yesterday with the time each one came in, its first response time and its call attempts so far. Show CRM IDs only, never client names. Read only. Don't change anything.

claude.title: Schedule the Lead Desk Monitor
claude.detail: In the Claude app, set up a scheduled task and paste the prompt. Fill in the brackets and keep only the line for your team.

button.label: Copy prompt
button.text:
You are our Lead Desk Monitor. You report to [TEAM LEAD'S NAME]. You run on a schedule with nobody watching, so follow these steps exactly.
Use the lead-source-review skill's speed-to-lead standard: a human call or text within 5 minutes of an online inquiry, referrals within the hour, after-hours leads by 9 the next morning, and 8 call attempts in the first week if the lead hasn't answered. The clock starts when the lead lands, and an auto-reply does not count.
[Connected teams, keep this line:] Using Sisu, pull our new leads from the last 14 days, with when each one came in, its first response time and its call attempts so far. If Sisu doesn't answer, say so and read the newest report in AI Office / Lead Desk / inbox instead.
[Export teams, keep this line:] Read the newest speed-to-lead report in AI Office / Lead Desk / inbox. If there is no report from the last 7 days, say what is missing and stop. Never guess.
Your last run is the newest dated list at the top of AI Office / Leadership Desk. If there is none, use the last 7 days. Check first touch for every lead that came in since your last run. Check call attempts for every lead whose first week ended since your last run.
List every lead that missed the standard: the CRM link or ID (never a client name), the source, the agent, minutes to first touch and attempts so far. Biggest miss first. If nothing missed, say so in one line.
Add the list, with today's date, to the top of AI Office / Leadership Desk. Don't change or delete anything else on the page.
Then create a Gmail draft to [TEAM LEAD'S EMAIL]. Use the subject "Lead Desk Monitor: Misses" and today's date, and put the list in the body. Save it as a draft. Do not send it.
Then add each agent's follow-up list, with today's date, to the top of AI Office / Team Board. Under each agent's name, list their leads from your list that still need work: the CRM link or ID (never a client name), the source, and what is due next, a first call or text or the next call attempt. Leave out minutes and attempt counts here, and leave out any agent with nothing due. If nobody has anything due, add one line that says so. Don't change or delete anything else on the page.
If one step fails, keep going with the others, and add a line at the top of the list that says which step failed and why.
Read only. You may save drafts, save files in the AI Office and post to its desk pages. Never send an email. Never call, text, reassign or update a lead. Never change the books, a lead, or anything else in a connected app. Don't change or delete any file, except adding the list to the top of the Leadership Desk and the follow-up lists to the top of the Team Board.

claude.title: Set the time
claude.detail: Connected teams: weekdays at 7:00 AM MT. Export teams: Mondays at 7:00 AM MT. Leave the folder empty.

claude.title: Save the task and run it once
claude.detail: Make sure Google Drive, Gmail and, for connected teams, Sisu are on for the task. Click Schedule, then run it once now, so you see a misses list and the follow-up lists today.

claude.text: Each run lands in three places. The misses list goes to the top of the Leadership Desk, with a copy as a Gmail draft to the team lead. Each agent's follow-up list goes to the top of the Team Board. Nothing is sent.

claude.title: About This Step
paras: The Lead Desk Monitor checks new leads against the speed-to-lead standard. It puts the misses on the Leadership Desk, with a copy as a Gmail draft to the team lead, and each agent's follow-up list on the Team Board.
It reads only. It never calls, texts, reassigns or updates a lead, and it never sends.

claude.detail: Open the Team Board. Each agent with something due shows under their name, with the lead's CRM link or ID, its source and what is due next. Every agent can open this page, so make sure it reads the way you want.

claude.title: Make sure no client names show
claude.detail: On both pages and in the draft: CRM links or IDs only. If a client name shows, tell the chat to drop it and fix the task.

claude.title: Tell your agents where to look
claude.detail: Agents open the Team Board, view only. Tell them their follow-up list shows there after every run, and that nothing on it gets sent to a client.

claude.title: Fill in the Lead Desk Monitor's seat card
claude.detail: Fill it in here, together. For Took Over, use your Week 0 baseline: Baseline task 2, checking one day of new leads for first touch and attempts. Write your minutes per occurrence, or "not done today." For First Run, use the date of the misses list you just checked. A made-up team's finished card is in this week's Kit.

claude.title: Sign the seat card
claude.detail: Read it, then sign it in the form. Your signature says you know what it reads, what it drafts, who it reports to and what it can't do.

claude.title: Turn in your checkpoint
claude.detail: Upload a screenshot of the first misses list before the next live build on Wed, Dec 16, 2026 at 12:00 PM MT. The signed seat card comes in through the form.
